title: Weather-Watching Results
description: Roll 1d6 when watching the weather: 6 is Clear Skies, 5-4 is Continuation, 3-1 is A Change for the Worse. A chart of the area makes travel safer, but does not change this table.

outcomes.name: Clear Skies
outcomes.description: Whatever the weather was doing before, it clears.

prompts.text: A period of comfortable sunshine that brings easy-to-hunt creatures to the surface.
A light rain, followed by a blossoming of flowers and ripening of fruits.
A strong but pleasant wind that clears away sporeclouds and mists and increases visibility.

outcomes.name: Continuation
outcomes.description: The weather continues as it is, for good or ill.

prompts.text: A period of uncomfortable warmth drags on.
If you are lucky, perfect sailing conditions persist.

outcomes.name: A Change for the Worse
outcomes.description: The weather is about to turn against you.

prompts.text: Driving rain or hail that lowers visibility and makes it harder to perform actions out on deck.
Blazing sunshine that threatens heatstroke, evaporates liquids, and brings out hordes of stinging insects.
A living storm or other bizarre weather phenomenon bearing down on you, hateful and hankering.
